The soil [माती] should be leveled, and bunds should be strong. 2. Take care that water [पाणी] does not get stored in the soil [माती]. 3. Dig trenches [चर] at appropriate intervals to ensure good drainage of water [पाणी] from the soil [माती]. 4. Maintain the water table [पाण्याची पातळी] at a depth of more than 2 meters. 5. Water [पाणी] and soluble fertilizers should be applied to cash crops as per requirement and according to the growth [वाढ] stage of the crop [पीक]. 6. If a canal is flowing through your area, prevent the water [पाणी] from seeping into the soil [माती]. 7. Maintain the soil structure [जमीनीची रचना / मृदा रचना] by using organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] and green manure crops [हिरवळीची खतपिके]. This helps to keep the air circulating and assists in draining excess water [पाणी]. 8. If well water [पाणी] is highly saline, mix it with good water [पाणी] and use it for irrigation [सिंचन]. 9. Regularly test the soil [माती] and water [पाणी] and obtain information about physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] and chemical changes in the soil [माती] from soil [माती] scientists. 10. Adopt micro-irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] and sprinkler irrigation [तुषार सिंचन] methods. 11. For saline and sodic soils, select crops as per their sensitivity, as follows: **Sensitivity of Crops to Saline and Sodic Soils** ``` ---- **Natural Farming Training Toolkit & Best Practices Guide** Source: नीती आयोग ``` - Whapasa: A method that encourages soil moisture [मातीचा ओलावा] conservation by promoting earthworm activity, which aids in the formation of water [पाणी] vapour condensation within the soil [माती]. - Mix cropping/ Inter cropping: This practice involves growing two or more crops simultaneously on the same piece of land [जमीन] to maximise the use of resources and enhance biodiversity [जैवविविधता]. - Cover Crop [आच्छादन पीक / आवरण पीक]/ 365 Days Soil [माती] Cover/Green Manuring [हिरवळीचे खत]: This involves planting specific crops to keep the soil [माती] covered throughout the year, which protects it from erosion [धूप/झीज], improves soil health [मृदा आरोग्य], and can be incorporated as green manure [हिरवळीचे खत / हिवरळीची खत] to boost fertility [प्रजननक्षमता]. - Minimum Tillage [किमान मशागत]/ Zero Tillage [जमिनीची मशागत]: This approach minimizes or completely avoids disturbing the soil [माती] through ploughing [नांगरणी], which helps to preserve soil structure [जमीनीची रचना / मृदा रचना], organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], and beneficial microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव]. *Whapasa* The process involves cultivating aeration [हवा खेळती ठेवणे] in the soil [माती] in order to enhance water [पाणी] vapor condensation. The process enhances the fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] of soil [माती] using cow dung [शेण], flour of pulses and jaggery [गूळ] concoction. ``` ---- **MPKV Krishi Darshani** Source: महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ (MPKV), राहुरी ``` A) **Saline Soil [क्षारयुक्त माती]** | Characteristics of Saline Soil [क्षारयुक्त माती] | | --- | | A thin layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] of white salt [मीठ] appears on the surface of the soil [माती]. | | --- | | pH is less than 8.5. | | --- | | Good drainage. | | --- | | Electrical conductivity [विद्युत प्रवाहक्षमता (EC)] of the soil [माती] solution is more than 4 dS/m and exchangeable sodium percentage (ESP) is less than 15%. | | --- | **Reclamation of Saline Soil [क्षारयुक्त माती सुधारणा]:** 1. Give a 1% slope to the land [जमीन]. 2. Dig trenches [चर] at appropriate distances across the slope of the field [शेत]. 3. Irrigate the field [शेत] thoroughly and drain out the soluble salts through the trenches [चर]. 4. Include green manure crops [हिरवळीची खतपिके] in crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट]. 5. Grow salt [मीठ]-tolerant crops. 6. Do not leave irrigated land [जमीन] fallow; always keep the land [जमीन] under crop [पीक], otherwise the land [जमीन] will become more saline. 7. Use mulching [आच्छादन] on the soil [माती] surface. B) **Alkaline (Sodic) Soil [माती]** | Characteristics of Alkaline (Sodic) Soil [माती] | | --- | | The exchangeable sodium percentage (ESP) of the soil [माती] is more than 15%. | | --- | | The electrical conductivity [विद्युत प्रवाहक्षमता (EC)] is less than 4 dS/m and the pH ranges from 8.5 to 10. | | --- | | Unsatisfactory drainage of water [पाणी] from the soil [माती]. | | --- | | The soil [माती] becomes hard on drying [वाळवणे], develops cracks [भेगा], and becomes extremely sticky when wet. The soil [माती] has poor aeration [हवा खेळती ठेवणे], which hinders proper crop [पीक] growth [वाढ]. | | --- | **Reclamation [सुधारणा] of Alkaline (Sodic) Soil [माती]:** ``` ---- **Natural Farming Training Toolkit & Best Practices Guide** Source: नीती आयोग ``` 3.4 Crop Rotation [पीक फेरपालट] Crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट] is the practice of growing different types of crops in succession on the same field [शेत] to gain benefits for soil [माती] and crop [पीक] systems (Fig [अंजीर]. 3.2). The beneficial effects of this are a decrease in the incidence of weeds [तण], insects, and plant diseases [वनस्पती रोग]. Besides, it also enhances the soil [माती]'s physical [शारीरिक तपासणी], chemical, and biological properties. While monocropping [एकल पीक पद्धती] exhausts the soil [माती] of its nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] and depletes its fertility [प्रजननक्षमता], crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट] helps prevent this from happening. The use of leguminous crops [शेंगायुक्त पीक] in rotation practices is commonly known (Fig [अंजीर]. 3.3). The advantages [फायदे] of including legumes include reduced soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप], restored fertility [प्रजननक्षमता], improved soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन], and nitrogen [नत्र] supplementation through nitrogen fixation [नायट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण]. Incorporating crop residue [पिकांचे अवशेष / पीक अवशेष] is often beneficial in the field [शेत] asit improves organic matter content [सेंद्रिय पदार्थांचे प्रमाण] in the soil [माती] and enhances overall soil health [मृदा आरोग्य]. Besides, it also reduces water [पाणी] requirements. High canopy [पर्णछाया] cover crops [आच्छादन पीक] are also used in this method, as they help sustain soil fertility [मातीची सुपीकता / मृदा सुपीकता], suppress weed [तण] growth [वाढ], decrease pest [कीड] and disease [रोग] infestation, and increase input use efficiency and system [पद्धत/प्रणाली] productivity. It also helps reduce soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप]. Fig [अंजीर]. 3.2: Crop Rotation [पीक फेरपालट] Model Fig [अंजीर] 3.3: Leguminous Crops [शेंगायुक्त पीक] for Sustainable Crop [पीक] Rotations Crops' rotation conserves soil moisture [मातीचा ओलावा], breaks pest [कीड] cycles, and improves soil structure [जमीनीची रचना / मृदा रचना]. Example Rotation: Maize [मका] Cowpea [चवळी] Sorghum [ज्वारी] Green manure [हिरवळीचे खत / हिवरळीची खत] Rotation Principles: - Alternate deep-rooted crops (e.g., cotton [कापूस], pigeon pea [तूर]) with shallow-rooted crops (e.g., mung bean, green gram [मूग]). - Introduce short-duration legumes after water [पाणी]-intensive crops to replenish soil [माती] nitrogen [नत्र] and retain moisture. - Rotate crops with different growth [वाढ] periods to prevent excessive water [पाणी] demand at one time. ``` ---- **Natural Farming Training Toolkit & Best Practices Guide** Source: नीती आयोग ``` Integrating livestock [पशुधन] into farming [शेती करणे] systems is vital for enhancing agricultural sustainability [कृषी टिकाऊपणा]. Maintaining a thriving soil microbiome [मृदा सूक्ष्मजीवसमूह] is crucial for sustaining the health [आरोग्य] of soil [माती], plants, animals, and humans. To achieve this, farmlands should remain covered with crops for the majority of the year. Cultivating a diverse range of crops helps to improve soil fertility [मातीची सुपीकता / मृदा सुपीकता]. Minimizing soil [माती] disturbance is crucial; therefore, practices like no-till farming [शून्य मशागत शेती] or shallow tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] are recommended. One of the key strategies for maintaining soil organic matter [मृदा सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] is fostering a robust microbiome, which can be further stimulated using biostimulants [बायोस्टिम्युलंट्स (जैविक उत्तेजक) / जैव उत्तेजक]. Effective pest control [कीड नियंत्रण] should be achieved primarily through improved farming [शेती करणे] techniques, as outlined in Integrated Pest Management [एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन] (IPM). Neem [कडूलिंब]-based solutions, sour buttermilk and other botanicals [वनस्पतीजन्य कीटकनाशक] will be regularly used to control [नियंत्रण] insect [कीटक] and disease [रोग] infestations. According to experienced practitioners, the following core principles are fundamental to successful natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती]. - * Beejamrit*: A seed treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया] method that utilizes a mixture of cow dung [शेण], cow [गाय] urine [मूत्र], and lime [चुना]-based solutions to enhance seed health [बियाण्याचे आरोग्य]. - * Jeevamrit*: A natural soil enrichment [मृद सुधारणा] technique that improves fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] through a blend of cow [गाय] urine [मूत्र], dung [शेण], jaggery [गूळ], and pulse [डाळ] flour. - Mulching [आच्छादन]: The practice of covering the soil [माती] with organic [सेंद्रिय] materials such as crop [पीक] residues and biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] to retain moisture and improve soil [माती] conditions. - Plant Protection [वनस्पती संरक्षण]: The use of organic [सेंद्रिय] sprays made from natural ingredients to prevent pests, diseases, and weeds [तण] while also supporting soil fertility [मातीची सुपीकता / मृदा सुपीकता]. - Whapasa: A method that encourages soil moisture [मातीचा ओलावा] conservation by promoting earthworm activity, which aids in the formation of water [पाणी] vapour condensation within the soil [माती]. - Mix cropping/ Inter cropping: This practice involves growing two or more crops simultaneously on the same piece of land [जमीन] to maximise the use of resources and enhance biodiversity [जैवविविधता]. - Cover Crop [आच्छादन पीक / आवरण पीक]/ 365 Days Soil [माती] Cover/Green Manuring [हिरवळीचे खत]: This involves planting specific crops to keep the soil [माती] covered throughout the year, which protects it from erosion [धूप/झीज], improves soil health [मृदा आरोग्य], and can be incorporated as green manure [हिरवळीचे खत / हिवरळीची खत] to boost fertility [प्रजननक्षमता]. ``` ---- **MPKV Krishi Darshani** Source: महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ (MPKV), राहुरी ``` **Reclamation [सुधारणा] of Calcareous Soil [माती]** 1. Deep plowing [खोल नांगरणी] should be done. 2. Use FYM/ green manuring [हिरवळीचे खत] in plenty. 3. Use well graded micronutrient [सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्य / सूक्ष्म मूलद्रव्ये] based on soil testing [माती परीक्षण] either from chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] and/ or foliar spray [पानांवरील फवारणी]. 4. Choose salt tolerance [क्षार सहनशीलता] crops as Citaphal, Bor, Aoula, Anjir, Sunflower [सूर्यफूल / सुर्यफुल], Tur, Soya bean, cotton [कापूस] etc **Subsurface Drainage [जमिनीखालून निचरा] System [पद्धत/प्रणाली] for Reclamation [सुधारणा] of Salt Affected Soil [क्षारयुक्त माती]** Dig trenches [चर] of 90 cm to 180 cm depth with the help of JCB machine. A collector drain of 600 meters length should be laid with a slope of 0.3% and a slope of 0.2% for lateral drains. Keeping the distance between the two laterals at 25 meters and connecting each 75-meter lateral to the collector drain perpendicularly. For a total of 30 lateral and 2 collector drains, corrugated PVC 80 mm diameter pipe with a non-perforated surface should be used and a 0.3% slope should be maintained to it. Every 25 meters 75 meter perforated corrugated PVC 80 mm pipes should be joined to the corrugated PVC 80 mm pipe with T joints The inspection chamber should be installed after every 4 laterals which is connected to collector drain. 3.5 feet wide and 8 feet height cement rings should be use for the construction The out let water [पाणी] drained throw in Inspection chamber it should be taken in to sump well with 4-meter-diameter and 5-meter depth. The water [पाणी] in the sump well is pumped and released in near by big natural trench. It can be done in 50,000 /- Rupees expenditure. **A. Advantages [फायदे] of Drainage System [निचरा व्यवस्था]** 1. Creates a suitable soil [माती] atmosphere for crop [पीक] growth [वाढ]. Helps in keeping the soil [माती] aerated. Therefore, the beneficial microbes in the soil [माती] increase. 2. The depth of the effective root zone [मुळांचा भाग] increases, and the crop [पीक] grows vigorously. 3. Improves soil structure [जमीनीची रचना / मृदा रचना], and water infiltration [पाणी मुरणे / पाणि झिरपण्याची क्षमता] increases. 4. Facilitates proportionate tillage [जमिनीची मशागत]. 5. Maintains a suitable soil temperature [मृद तापमान] for the crop [पीक]. 6. The accumulation of salts on the surface of the soil [माती] slows down, and the soil [माती] becomes suitable for cultivation. 7. Early access due to better soil [माती] workability is facilitated, and seed germination [बियाणे अंकुरण] increases. **8\. Different Drainage System [निचरा व्यवस्था] Layouts** ``` ---- **Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth** Source: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, अकोला ``` | **Month** | | **Nitrogen [नत्र]**

**(grams/tree)**

**(grams/tree)**

**P2O5 / tree** | **Potash**

**(grams/tree) K2O/g/tree** | | --- | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Mrig Bahar** | **Ambiya Bahar** | | November | June | 48 | 20 | 24 | | 48 | 20 | 24 | | December | July | 24 | 0 | 20 | | 24 | 0 | 20 | | January | August | 24 | 0 | 20 | | 24 | 0 | 20 | | February | September | 24 | 0 | 20 | | 24 | 0 | 20 | | March | October | 24 | 0 | 20 | | 24 | 0 | 20 | _Nitrogen/Phosphorus [स्फुरद]/Potash grams per tree at 15 days intervals_ **Training [प्रशिक्षण] and Pruning [फांद्या छाटणी]:** Train young plants using the single stem method and provide training [प्रशिक्षण] accordingly. Remove excess shoots from mature trees every year after harvesting [कापणी] fruits. Always remove water [पाणी] sprouts. Apply Bordeaux paste to the cut surfaces after removing shoots. **Intercropping [आंतरपीक]:** Take intercrops for the first 3-4 years (before fruit bearing [फळधारणा]). In the first year, take Thigani (groundnut [भुईमूग / भुईमुग]), short duration vegetables, green manure [हिरवळीचे खत / हिवरळीची खत], or pulse [डाळ] crops. Subsequently, take a green manure crop [हिरवळीचे खत पीक / हिरवळीची खतपिके]. Keep the basins clean by weeding [तण काढणे] or using appropriate herbicides [तणनाशके]. Avoid intercropping [आंतरपीक] with sorghum [ज्वारी] or cotton [कापूस]. ``` ---- **Krushi VNMAU** Source: वसंतराव नाईक मराठवाडा कृषी विद्यापीठ (VNMAU) ``` Green manure [हिरवळीचे खत / हिवरळीची खत] use has an important place in organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]. It is more beneficial to produce this manure [खत] from mixed crops than to produce it from one type of crop [पीक]. If the above principles of organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] are kept in mind and the planning is done accordingly, an ideal organic [सेंद्रिय] farm [शेत] or organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] can be achieved in a period of 4 to 5 years. **Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]:** **Definition and Concept of Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]:** The farming [शेती करणे] method in which the use of synthetic fertilizers [रासायनिक खत], pesticides and insecticides [कीटकनाशके], herbicides [तणनाशके], and other chemical components for boosting productivity is completely eliminated, and the living state of the soil [माती] is made the central focus, with the fertility [प्रजननक्षमता], structure, and nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] of the soil [माती] being maintained, and in fact increased, is what is known as organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]. Generally speaking, organic farming methods [सेंद्रिय शेती पद्धती] involve using organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते], animal excrement, crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट], intercropping [आंतरपीक], green manure [हिरवळीचे खत / हिवरळीची खत], compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] from farm [शेत] waste, vermicompost [गांडूळखत], the use of beneficial bacterial cultures, the use of organic [सेंद्रिय] and natural components for crop protection [पीक संरक्षण], the use of disease [रोग] and pest [कीड]-resistant species [प्रजाती] and seeds, and so on, for permanently maintaining or increasing soil fertility [मातीची सुपीकता / मृदा सुपीकता] and productivity, and these are the major components of organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]. In this farming [शेती करणे] method, the source of the inputs used is also mandatorily organic [सेंद्रिय]. This farming [शेती करणे] method is mutually dependent on all living organisms in the ecosystem. **Benefits of the Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] Method:** - The natural and biological fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] of the soil [माती] is maintained. - Environmental balance is maintained. - The quality of agricultural production [उत्पादन] is enhanced, and storage [साठवण] capacity is increased. - The population of friendly insects and beneficial organisms grows rapidly, preventing the infestation of harmful insects. - The rate of soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] is reduced. - Livestock [पशुधन] can be used extensively for farming [शेती करणे]. - The water-holding capacity [पाणी धरणक्षमता / पाणी धारण क्षमता] of the soil [माती] increases. - Agricultural produce from organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] is free of the toxic residue of insecticide [कीटकनाशक] and fungicide [बुरशीनाशक] substances. **Testing, Inspection, and Certification for Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]:** ``` ---- **Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth** Source: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, अकोला ``` **Intercropping [आंतरपीक]:** Take intercrops for the first 3-4 years (before fruit bearing [फळधारणा]). In the first year, take Thigani (groundnut [भुईमूग / भुईमुग]), short duration vegetables, green manure [हिरवळीचे खत / हिवरळीची खत], or pulse [डाळ] crops. Subsequently, take a green manure crop [हिरवळीचे खत पीक / हिरवळीची खतपिके]. Keep the basins clean by weeding [तण काढणे] or using appropriate herbicides [तणनाशके]. Avoid intercropping [आंतरपीक] with sorghum [ज्वारी] or cotton [कापूस]. **Bahar Management [व्यवस्थापन] (Inducing Flowering):** Give stress (withholding irrigation [सिंचन]) before the Mrig/Ambiya flowering, considering the moisture content [आर्द्रता] of the soil [माती], the age of the tree, and its vigor. For the Mrig bahar, in medium soils, give 50 days of stress (April 25 to June 15) for orange [संत्री] trees, and 30 days of stress for the Ambiya bahar (December 15 to January 15). **Ambiya Bahar:** Fruit drop [फळ गळणे] in the Ambiya bahar occurs during August to October. To reduce this, spray NAA 10 PPM (10 mg plant [रोप/वनस्पती] growth regulator [वाढ नियंत्रक] per liter of water [पाणी]) and 1% urea [यूरिया] (10 grams urea [यूरिया] per liter of water [पाणी]) every month during this period. Do not carry out deep tillage [खोल नांगरणी] of the orchard during the fruit setting [फळधारणा] period. **Mrig Bahar:** To reduce fruit drop [फळ गळणे] in the Mrig bahar of oranges and for increased production [उत्पादन] and economic returns, perform the first spray of 15 PPM GA-3 (Gibberellic Acid) with 15 PPM CPPU (Forchlorfenuron) or Brassinolide 2 PPM when the flowering starts, and the second spray when the fruits are pea [वाटाणा / वाटणा]-sized. **Applying Paste to the Trunk:** Apply Bordeaux paste (1:1:10) to the trees up to a height of 1 meter in June and October. **Season [हंगाम/ऋतू]:** - **Ambiya Bahar Flowering:** January - February, and **Harvesting [कापणी]:** November - December - **Mrig Bahar Flowering:** June - July, and **Harvesting [कापणी]:** February - March.Mulch [आच्छादन] the orchard to reduce fruit drop [फळ गळणे] during summer. **Production [उत्पादन]:** 5 to 8 years: Orange [संत्री] - 150 to 400 fruits, Mosambi - 100 to 300 fruits per tree 9 years and above: Orange [संत्री] - 800 to 1000 fruits, Mosambi - 400 to 600 fruits per tree ```

results.question: मक्यामध्ये नत्राच्या कमतरतेची चिन्हे काय आहेत?
results.answer:
मक्यात नत्राची कमतरता आल्यास पाने आणि वाढ यावर लक्षणे दिसतात.

**लक्षणे:**
- झाडाच्या जुन्या (पक्व) पानांना प्रथम पिवळेपणा येतो; कमतरता जास्त असल्यास खालच्या बाजूपासून वरपर्यंत सगळी पाने पिवळी दिसतात.
- मुळांची आणि झाडाची वाढ थांबते, म्हणजे मका उंच होण्याऐवजी कमी वाढतो.
- नवीन फुटवे आणि फुलांची संख्या कमी होते.

**उपाय:**
- यूरिया अथवा इतर नत्रयुक्त रासायनिक खते आवश्यकतेनुसार द्या.

**स्रोत: वसंतराव नाईक मराठवाडा कृषी विद्यापीठ (व्ही.एन.एम.ए.यू.) पोषण कमतरता माहिती**

आपल्या मक्याचे आज सुमारे किती दिवस झाले आहेत?

**STANDARD VETERINARY TREATMENT GUIDELINES FOR LIVESTOCK AND POULTRY**
Source: पशुसंवर्धन व दुग्धव्यवसाय विभाग, भारत सरकार
```
Diagnosis [निदान]

Vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव] should be suspected when any litters are born dead or weak, as also when abnormalities of the eyes [डोळे] are present in newborn piglets. If the litters of young pigs are very susceptible to enteritis and pneumonia, or if paralysis of the hindquarters is often seen in pigs in the piggery, then it is necessary to check if there is enough green feed [खाद्य/चारा]/fodder [चारा] or vitamin A in the diet.

Enteritis, pneumonia and paralysis are not necessarily caused by vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव]. A common disease [रोग] causing a similar birth of dead piglets is leptospirosis [लेप्टोस्पायरोसिस]. In this disease [रोग], the infected sow [मादी डुक्कर] does not show any obvious symptom [लक्षण] until she aborts, which may occur two to four weeks before farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] takes place. If the sow [मादी डुक्कर] farrows at full time, the piglets are born dead or weak. For diagnosis [निदान] of hypovitaminosis A, testing of sow [मादी डुक्कर]'s blood [रक्त] serum [सिरम] is essential.

Treatment [उपचार] and control [नियंत्रण]

When there are obvious symptoms [लक्षणे] of vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव], a dose [मात्रा] of 10 000 IU of the vitamin A supplement should be given as a drench. Pigs suffering from vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव] will usually respond very quickly when the vitamin is supplied in adequate amounts, but animals with advanced symptoms [लक्षणे] such as marked muscular incoordination or blindness seldom recover completely.

Control [नियंत्रण]

To prevent the occurrence of vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव], good quality fresh green feed [खाद्य/चारा] should be provided daily, or a vitamin A supplement added to the feed [खाद्य/चारा]. About 60 g of green feed [खाद्य/चारा] should be provided to each pig [वराह] daily. Whole milk [दूध] has fairly large amounts of vitamin A, but skim milk [स्किम्ड दूध] is a very poor source as are most milk [दूध] products, meat [मांस] meal [जेवण] and grain [धान्य] (except maize [मका] which is very high in carotene). Cod liver oil and fish [मासे] oils contain large amounts of vitamin A and can be used as supplements, but it is easier and cheaper to use one of the commercial synthetic stabilized vitamin A supplements. These can be obtained in powder or liquid emulsion form for mixing with the feed [खाद्य/चारा]; details about the quantities to be fed are supplied with the various preparations. Many commercial preparations contain vitamin A together with vitamin D.
```

6.3.6 Goose stepping (Pantothenic acid deficiency)

Definition and etiology [रोगकारण]

Pantothenic acid, also known as vitamin B5, is essential for normal physiological functions in pigs. It plays an important role in the synthesis and metabolism of carbohydrates, proteins and fats. Deficiency of this vitamin can lead to a variety of clinical symptoms [लक्षणे], particularly affecting growing pigs and pregnant sows.

Inadequate dietary intake of pantothenic acid, particularly in growing pigs and pregnant sows, lead to the development of deficiency symptoms [लक्षणे]. Lowquality or improperly formulated feeds may lack sufficient levels of essential vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे] and minerals [खनिजे], including pantothenic acid. Any concurrent gastrointestinal disease [रोग]/problems that affect the absorption of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] from the gastrointestinal tract can also contribute to deficiencies.

Clinical signs

Clinical signs include loss of appetite [भूक कमी होणे], leading to significant weight loss [वजन कमी होणे] and poor growth [वाढ] rates. Goose-stepping gait is a distinctive, exaggerated high-stepping style of walking [चालणे], primarily affecting the hind limbs, that is commonly observed in pigs with this deficiency. It results from nerve damage and muscle weakness [अशक्तपणा / दुर्बलता], resulting in a lack of muscle coordination leading to an unsteady and staggering walk. Non-infectious bloody diarrhoea [अतिसार] in few cases is also reported. In severe deficiency, death may occur as a result of complete anorexia.

Diagnosis [निदान]

Diagnosis [निदान] of deficiency cannot always be made based only on response to nutritional therapy, particularly if it is a long-term deficiency. A nutritional deficiency needs to be diagnosed based on several factors such as clinical signs, dietary review, presence of diseases and management [व्यवस्थापन] history.
```

results.answer:
जमिनीतील सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढवण्यासाठी खालील सेंद्रिय मार्ग नियमितपणे वापरल्यास मातीची सुपीकता आणि पाणी धरण्याची क्षमता चांगली होते.

**सेंद्रिय खत वापर:** शेणखत, कंपोस्ट आणि गांडूळखत यासारखी घन खते नियमितपणे द्या; तसेच रायझोबियम, पी.एस.बी., अॅझोटोबॅक्टर इ. जीवाणू खतेही वापरा.

**हिरवळीचे खत:** ढैंचा, ग्लाय्रिसिडिया, गिरिपुष्प यांसारखी हिरवळीची खतपिके घेऊन ती जमिनीत बुडवा (स्रोताप्रमाणे दर तीन वर्षांनी एकदा).

**पिकांचे अवशेष व्यवस्थापन:** पेरणीपूर्वी किंवा पिकाच्या काढणीनंतर १/३ भाग पिकाचे अवशेष न जाळता जमिनीत बुडवा; कुजण्यासाठी ट्रायकोडर्मा बुरशी वापरू शकता.

**आच्छादन (मल्चिंग):** ऊसाचा कचरा, गव्हाचा भुसा किंवा इतर पिकांचे अवशेष जमिनीवर आच्छादन म्हणून ठेवा.

**जमिनीची मशागत व संवर्धन:** जमिनीची मशागत कमी करा आणि पातळीकरण करा; माती व पाणी संवर्धनामुळे धूप टाळली जाते.

**पीक फेरपालट व आंतरपीक:** डाळींची पिके फेरपालटीत किंवा आंतरपीकात समाविष्ट करा.

**एकात्मिक शेती:** शेती-पशुपालन एकात्मिक करा; शेताच्या सीमेला वारा थांबवणारे रोपे आणि हिरवळीची खतपिके लावा.

**स्रोत: वसंतराव नाईक मराठवाडा कृषी विद्यापीठ (व्ही.एन.एम.ए.यू.), महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ (एम.पी.के.व्ही.)**

In saline and sodic soils, a large amount of nitrogen [नत्र] is lost. For this, it is beneficial to give 25% more nitrogenous fertilizer [खत] than the recommended dose [मात्रा]. Besides, deficiencies of phosphorus [स्फुरद], iron [लोह], and zinc [झिंक] are also commonly found. It is therefore necessary to use chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] along with compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत], which helps to maintain soil fertility [मातीची सुपीकता / मृदा सुपीकता].

**Precautions to prevent soils from becoming saline or sodic:**

1. The soil [माती] should be leveled, and bunds should be strong.
2. Take care that water [पाणी] does not get stored in the soil [माती].
3. Dig trenches [चर] at appropriate intervals to ensure good drainage of water [पाणी] from the soil [माती].
4. Maintain the water table [पाण्याची पातळी] at a depth of more than 2 meters.
5. Water [पाणी] and soluble fertilizers should be applied to cash crops as per requirement and according to the growth [वाढ] stage of the crop [पीक].
6. If a canal is flowing through your area, prevent the water [पाणी] from seeping into the soil [माती].
7. Maintain the soil structure [जमीनीची रचना / मृदा रचना] by using organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] and green manure crops [हिरवळीची खतपिके]. This helps to keep the air circulating and assists in draining excess water [पाणी].
8. If well water [पाणी] is highly saline, mix it with good water [पाणी] and use it for irrigation [सिंचन].
9. Regularly test the soil [माती] and water [पाणी] and obtain information about physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] and chemical changes in the soil [माती] from soil [माती] scientists.

results.question: What is the treatment for Milk Fever in buffaloes?
results.answer:
मुरगा (बकरी/गाय) यांमध्ये दूध ताप म्हणजे रक्तातील कॅल्शियम अचानक कमी होणे, त्यामुळे शरीर दुर्बल होते आणि उठू शकत नाही; उपचार म्हणून पशुवैद्याच्या मदतीने रक्तकॅल्शियम वाढवणे आवश्यक आहे.

**उपचार:**
- त्वरित पशुवैद्यकाला बोला — लक्षणे दिसताच वेळ गेला तर प्राण जाऊ शकतात.
- व्हेनमध्ये कॅल्शियम द्रावण देणे (जसे की कॅल्शियम ग्लुकोनेट किंवा कॅल्शियम बोरोग्लुकोनेट); हे प्रभावीपणे देण्यासाठी पशुवैद्याची गरज असते.
- गंभीर परिस्थितीत सहाय्यक उपचार: द्रव थेरपी आणि प्रदাহरोधक औषधे लागू शकतात.
- काही जनावरांना २४–४८ तासांत पुन्हा आजारी पडू शकतात, त्यामुळे पुढील उपचार हवे असल्यास पशुवैद्यकाला सांगा.

**प्रतिबंध:**
- उशिरा गरोदरपणात कॅल्शियम पूरक अतिप्रमाणात खाऊ घालू नका.
- ज्यांना धोका आहे त्यांना व्यानेपूर्वी १२–२४ तास ते व्यानेनंतर ४८ तास या कालावधीत ३–४ वेळा ओरल कॅल्शियम द्या; प्रत्येक डोसामध्ये सुमारे ४०–५० ग्रॅम कॅल्शियम मिळेल अशा प्रकारचे डोस ठेवा.
- व्यानेपूर्वी शेवटच्या ३ आठवड्यांत अॅनॉनिक मीठ जसे अमोनियम क्लोराईड आणि मॅग्नेशियम सल्फेट किंवा अमोनियम सल्फेट (५०–१०० ग्रॅम प्रत्येकी/दिवस) खाऊ घालणे फायदेशीर ठरते.
- व्यानेच्या वेळी मूत्राचा पीएच सुमारे ६.५–७ असावा; पीएच जास्त असेल तर दूध तापाचा धोका वाढतो.

**स्रोत: हाँडबुक ऑफ गुड डेअरी हस्बंड्री प्रॅक्टिसेस (एन.डी.डी.बी.); एमर्जिंग ट्रेंड्स इन लाइव्हस्टॉक न्यूट्रिशन फॉर हेल्थ अँड प्रोडक्शन (एम.ए.एन.ए.जी.ई.)**

1.2.4 Downer Cow [गाय] Syndrome

Definition and Etiology [रोगकारण]

Downer cow [गाय] syndrome is a group of syndromes noticed as a complication to milk [दूध] fever [ताप] in high yielding dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] animals and is characterized by prolonged recumbency despite treatment [उपचार] with intravenous calcium [कॅल्शियम] preparation. Traumatic injury to limb muscles and nerves prior to parturition or at the time of parturition may also lead to downer.

Predisposing Factors

Delayed treatment [उपचार] of milk [दूध] fever [ताप], traumatic injury to sciatic nerve and pelvic muscle, serum [सिरम] electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] abnormality (Na, K, Mg, Ca) and slippery floor in the farm [शेत] premises.

Clinical Signs

Alert downers the animal is in sternal recumbency with normal feed [खाद्य/चारा] and water [पाणी] intake. Pulse [डाळ] and heart rates are initially normal but increase later. Creepers alert downer which makes repeated attempts to get up. Non-creeper alert downer cow [गाय], which makes no attempt to raise and prefers to remain in recumbency state. Non alert downer inappetence to anorexia, lateral recumbency.

Diagnosis [निदान]

History of recent parturition, dystocia, and prolonged recumbency. Elevated level of muscle specific enzymes, *viz.*, CPK (normal level - 40- 280 IU/litre) and AST. Decreased serum [सिरम] level of calcium [कॅल्शियम], phosphorus [स्फुरद] and magnesium. Mild to moderate proteinuria and ketonuria. Postmortem lesions include haemorrhage and degeneration in thigh muscles.

Differential Diagnosis [निदान]

Coliform mastitis [स्तनदाह] (presence of systemic signs and discolouration of milk [दूध] with enlarged udder [कास]) and fracture [हाड तुटणे] in limb (radiographic evidence of hip bone and or femur fracture [हाड तुटणे]).

I)Stage of increment/ chill/ onset:

- Under normal circumstances, daily scrubbing and washing of the floors, water [पाणी] troughs and mangers and the action of sunlight falling in the houses are sufficient enough to keep them moderately germ free. This should be supplemented with periodic white washing of the walls, mangers and troughs.
- When there is a disease outbreak [रोग उद्रेक], a more elaborate procedure of disinfection should be followed. All floors, walls up to the height of 1.5 m, interior of water trough [पिण्याचे तळ], mangers, other fittings and equipment coming in contact with animals should be disinfected.
- The first step is to remove all the filth and feed [खाद्य/चारा] residue. All dung [शेण], litter [कचरा], feed [खाद्य/चारा] residue should be removed and stacked so that the heat generated inside kills the germs. The floors, walls up to 1.5 m height, interior of mangers and water trough [पिण्याचे तळ] etc. are thoroughly scrubbed and washed with water [पाणी].
- In case of outbreak of anthrax [अँथ्रॅक्स], the dung [शेण], litter [कचरा] etc. should first be disinfected in situ by thorough sprinkling [पाण्याचा फवारणी] of suitable disinfectant. After removal of filth, the place should be scrubbed and washed with 4 % hot washing soda solution (i.e., 4 kg washing soda in 100 litre of boiling water [पाणी]). The approved disinfectant solution should be liberally sprinkled or sprayed and left so to act for 24 hours. After this, the shed [निवारा] should be washed with clean water [स्वच्छ पाणी] and left to dry [कोरडे] with wind [वारा] and sunlight.

**आहार संतुलन:**
- कुक्कुट खाद्य घटक मुख्य गटांत विभागले आहेत: तृणधान्ये (कार्बोहायड्रेट/ऊर्जा), प्रथिने संपन्न घटक (सोयाबीन जेवण, भुईमूग पेंड, सुर्यफूल पेंड, नारळ जेवण, तीळ पेंड, कॉटनसीड मील इ.), चरबी स्रोत, जीवनसत्त्व/खनिज पूरक आणि अॅडिटिव्ह.

शेतीत जीवामृताचा वापर केल्याने पिकांना पोषक तत्वे पुरेशी मिळतात, मातीतील उपयुक्त जिवाणूंची संख्या वाढते आणि पीक वाढीस चालना मिळते.

**फायदे:**
- पिकांना नत्र, स्फुरद, कॅल्शियम अशी अनेक पोषक तत्वे उपलब्ध होतात.
- मातीतील उपयुक्त जिवाणूंचा प्रमाण वाढून मातीचा पोत सुधारतो.
- पीक वाढीला उत्तेजना मिळते (क्रॉप ग्रोथ स्टिमुलंट).
- घरच्या शेण व घरच्या बेसन/हरभरा पिठाचा वापर केल्याने उत्पादन खर्च कमी होतो आणि उत्पन्न वाढण्यास मदत होते.
- गंधजीवामृत (घन) वापरल्यास मातीतील गांडुळांची संख्या वाढते आणि सेंद्रिय खतांचे विघटन वेगाने होते.

- काही पिकांमध्ये फवारणी किंवा डवरणे करताना २ लिटर जीवामृत ८ लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून वापरता येतो.
- तयार जीवामृत सात दिवसांच्या आत वापरावे; सावलीत तयार करावे.

**Integrated Nutrient Management [समन्वित अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मीक पोषक व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन] (INM):**

The method of using organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते], green manures, bacterial fertilizers, and organic [सेंद्रिय] liquids in appropriate proportions as complementary fertilizers along with chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] is called Integrated Nutrient Management [समन्वित अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मीक पोषक व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन].

In this method, a balance is maintained between chemical, organic [सेंद्रिय], and biological fertilizers [जैविक खत]. Also, by including leguminous crops [शेंगायुक्त पीक] in crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट], soil fertility [मातीची सुपीकता / मृदा सुपीकता] is maintained. In this method, along with bumper crop [पीक] production [उत्पादन], the quality of food grains [धान्ये] and soil [माती] is also improved. By saving expensive chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], soil productivity [मृदा उत्पादकता] is continuously improved year after year. In this method, generally half of the total requirement of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] is supplied through chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], and the remaining half is supplied through organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते]. It is recommended to take green manure crops [हिरवळीची खतपिके] and bury them in the soil [माती] once every three years. All crop [पीक] residues like sugarcane [ऊस] trash, sorghum [ज्वारी] stalks, wheat [गहू] and paddy stubble [खुंट], sunflower [सूर्यफूल / सुर्यफुल] stalks, and all residues of pulse [डाळ] crops, etc., are buried in the soil [माती] to increase the amount of organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ]. Along with this, it is necessary to use bacterial fertilizers and vermicompost [गांडूळखत].

**The following points should be considered while selecting chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:**

1. For long-term crops, compound fertilizers should be used (Nitrophosphate 15:15:15) (Ammo. Phosphate 28:28:0).
2. To facilitate the availability of phosphorus [स्फुरद], completely soluble fertilizers should be selected. E.g., Single Super Phosphate, Diammonium Phosphate.
3. Sulfur-containing fertilizers should be included for pulses and oilseeds. E.g., Ammonium Sulfate, Single Super Phosphate, Ammo. Phosphate, Sulfate.
4. To increase the efficiency of phosphorus [स्फुरद], phosphorus [स्फुरद]-solubilizing bacteria [जीवाणू] (PSB) fertilizers should be used.
5. To increase the efficiency of nitrogenous fertilizers, coated urea [यूरिया] should be used. (Neem [कडूलिंब] Coated Urea [यूरिया], Sulfur Coated Urea [यूरिया].)
6. Glyricidia or young branches of Subabul [सुबाभळ] should be used as green manures.
7. Sugarcane [ऊस] molasses [मोलासेस] from sugar factories, bacterial fertilizers (Bio Earth Compost [कंपोस्ट]) should be used.

4.Potassium [पालाश]:

Potassium [पालाश] is the third most abundant mineral in the animal body and serves as the primary intracellular ion, with concentrations ranging from 100 to 160 mmol/L in body tissues. It plays a crucial role in maintaining nerve and muscle excitability, as well as regulating the body's water balance [जल संतुलन] and acid-base equilibrium. Potassium [पालाश] is also involved in cellular respiration [श्वसन] through the chloride shift and influences various intracellular processes, including enzyme function and muscle contraction.

For herbivores, potassium [पालाश] deficiency is uncommon, as most forages naturally contain adequate levels of this mineral. However, when deficiency does occur, it can lead to symptoms [लक्षणे] such as muscle weakness [अशक्तपणा / दुर्बलता], stiffness, paralysis, and intracellular acidosis. In potassium [पालाश]-deficient animals, the reduction of potassium [पालाश] in milk [दूध] is more pronounced than in plasma [प्लाझ्मा]. Dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] calves with marginal potassium [पालाश] deficiency may show decreased appetite [भूक] and reduced weight gain [वजन वाढ], even when plasma [प्लाझ्मा] potassium [पालाश] levels appear normal.

5.Sulphur [गंधक]:

The identification of methionine, an essential amino acid containing one sulphur [गंधक] atom per molecule, highlighted the importance of sulphur [गंधक] as a dietary nutrient [पोषक घटक]. Sulphur [गंधक] is found in connective tissues as sulphate and is a component of the natural anticoagulant [रक्त गोठणे प्रतिबंधक द्रव्य] heparin [हेपारिन]. It is also present in important hormones such as insulin and oxytocin, as well as in vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे] like thiamine and biotin. Sulphur [गंधक] is abundant in keratin-rich structures including hooves [खुर], horns, feathers, wool fibre, and mohair. The rumen [रुमेन]'s microbial flora can incorporate inorganic sulphur [गंधक] into microbial proteins, which then serve as a high-quality amino acid source for the animal.

Symptoms [लक्षणे] of sulphur deficiency [गंधकाची कमतरता / गंधक कमतरता] include slowed growth [वाढ], excessive shedding of wool or hair, profuse salivation, excessive tearing, and in severe cases, emaciation leading to death.

Copper [तांबे] plays a crucial role in animal biology through its involvement in several copper [तांबे]-dependent enzymes. It is essential for the formation of hemoglobin and the transport of iron [लोह]. Copper [तांबे] is a rate-limiting element in the production [उत्पादन] of ceruloplasmin (ferroxidase), an enzyme necessary for oxidizing iron [लोह], which allows iron [लोह] to bind to its transport protein [प्रथिने], transferrin. The most consistent clinical sign of copper deficiency [तांब्याचा अभाव] in cattle [गाय वर्ग] is abnormal hair pigmentation, characterized by a change in coat color known as achromotrichia. This discoloration is especially noticeable around the eyesreferred to as "spectacling"as well

Diagnosis [निदान]

Diagnosis [निदान] often reveals low blood [रक्त] pH, *P*CO2 and bicarbonate levels, along with elevated D-lactate and blood [रक्त] urea [यूरिया] nitrogen [नत्र] (BUN).

Treatment [उपचार]

Depending on the extent of the disease [रोग] condition, intravenous isotonic 1.3-1.4 % solution of sodium bicarbonate solution is given as treatment [उपचार].

Alkalosis

Elevated blood [रक्त] pH is the hallmark of alkalemia, also known as metabolic alkalosis, which is often driven on by excessive acid loss, increased absorption of alkali, or a carbon dioxide deficiency.

Etiology [रोगकारण]

Metabolic alkalosis commonly arises from condition like abomasal atony, which may occur due to abomasal impaction. Under these events, potassium [पालाश] and hydrochloric acid are continuously secreted into the abomasum, resulting in hyperchloremic and hypokalaemia alkalosis. Furthermore, metabolic alkalosis can cause a shift in potassium [पालाश] from extracellular to intracellular locations, which may exacerbate hypokalaemia even in cases where the body potassium [पालाश] levels are acceptable.

Clinical signs

Animal alkalosis may be challenging to diagnose due to a lack of specific clinical symptoms [लक्षणे]. It frequently causes convulsions, tetany, tremors in the muscles, and shallow respirations. In more severe phases, dyspnoea and hyperpnea can appear.

Treatment [उपचार]

Treating alkalosis in animals involves fluid therapy with 0.9% isotonic saline along with electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] management [व्यवस्थापन], including giving potassium [पालाश] chloride (KCl) at 20-40 mEq/L IV, are crucial.

Electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] imbalances

Definition and causes

Net losses from gastrointestinal diseases account for most animal electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] abnormalities. The etiologies of electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] imbalance include vomiting, burn exudation, sweating, and excessive salivation. Nevertheless, these conditions are less prevalent in livestock [पशुधन], except ruminant [गुरे वर्ग] dysphagia and horse [घोडा] sweating.

The deficiency of vitamin A in young animals is manifested as the compression of brain and spinal cord whereas in adult animals the syndrome is characterized by night blindness, corneal keratinization, pityriasis, defects in the hooves [खुर], loss of weight, and infertility [वंध्यत्व]. ठिबक सिंचनाद्वारे सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये देण्याची सर्वोत्तम पद्धत म्हणजे **सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे** (फर्टिगेशन) वापरून पाणी-विद्राव्य खते योग्य प्रमाणात आणि योग्य वेळी मुळांच्या जवळ पोहोचवणे.

**पद्धत:**
- ठिबक सिंचन प्रणालीमध्ये व्हेंच्युरी प्रवाहमापी किंवा खत साठवण टाकी वापरून पाण्याबरोबर खते द्यावीत; या यंत्राशिवाय फर्टिगेशन करू नका, कारण त्यामुळे खतांचा वापर नियंत्रित होतो.
- माती परीक्षणानुसार खतांची मात्रा ठरवा, आणि पीक गरजेनुसार पाणी-विद्राव्य खते योग्य प्रमाणात मिसळून द्या.

**पाणी-विद्राव्य खतांची काही उदाहरणे:**
- मोनोपोटॅशियम फॉस्फेट

- कॅल्शियम नायट्रेट
- यूरिया फॉस्फेट
- पोटॅशियम सल्फेट

**सुक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये:**
- काही मार्गदर्शक तत्वे सुक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये फवारणीने देण्याचा उल्लेख करतात; तरी ठिबक प्रणालीमध्ये खते पाणी-विद्राव्य स्वरूपात, माती परीक्षणानुसार आणि पीक गरजेनुसार दिल्यास अधिक कार्यक्षमता मिळते.

**Crop [पीक]:** Sesame [तीळ] (तीळ) - **Pest [कीड]:** Gall Midge [गादमाशी] (गाद माशी)

Fertilizer Management [खत व्यवस्थापन]: At the time of planting rhizomes/cuttings [कापणी टप्पे]/seedlings, in addition to farmyard manure [शेणखत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] fertilizer [खत] in each pit, 10 gm Urea [यूरिया], 60 gm Single Super Phosphate and 10 gm Muriate of Potash fertilizers should be mixed well with the soil [माती]. After the vine is 1 month old, give 10 to 15 gm of urea [यूरिया] to each vine. The second installment of Nitrogen [नत्र] (15 gm Urea [यूरिया] per vine) should be given at the time of fruiting. After planting the tuber [कंद], the vines [वेली] start growing vigorously. At the same time, they should be supported on the trellis or stake with the help of proper support.  
Interculture: The surroundings of the vines [वेली] and surrounding area should be kept clean by weeding [तण काढणे]. Earthing up [रोपाभोवतीची माती ढकलुन रोपाला आधार देणे / भरणी करणे / भर देणे] should be done to the vines [वेली].  
Harvesting [कापणी]: The fruits on the vines [वेली] planted in June are ready for harvesting [कापणी] by the end of July. By harvesting [कापणी] the tender fruits regularly at intervals of four to six days, an average yield [उत्पादन] of 1.0 to 1.5 kg of fruits is obtained on each vine. Spiny gourd fruits are available till September. The vines [वेली] automatically start to dry [कोरडे] as the rainfall decreases.  
Yield [उत्पादन]: 100 to 150 quintals/hectare  
Diseases and Pests: Like vine vegetable crops, this crop [पीक] is also prone to diseases like powdery mildew [भुरी / भुरी रोग], downy mildew [केवडा रोग / केवडा / डाऊनी मिल्ड्यू], blight [ब्लाईट / करपा] and pests like fruit fly [फळमाशी], red beetles etc.  
Control [नियंत्रण]: Spraying [फवारणी] 5% neem oil [कडुलिंबाचे तेल] extract. Use Cue-lure [आमिष] pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] at the rate of 5 per acre. Collect the insected fruits and bury them in a deep pit.
